title: [AUG-198] Settings → AI assistants tab: status probe, assistant preferences, consents and the tab UI (per AUG-194 mockup)
why_we_need_this:
The Meeting Copilot (AUG-197) and the Active session (AUG-195 → impl) both need one place where the user picks modes, models, spending limits and gives consent, and both need to know whether Claude Code is installed and signed in and whether PraxisOS is running. AUG-194 produced the final, user-approved design and the full preferences / routes / detection spec; this task implements exactly that, so the copilot and the session can plug into it without re-deciding UI or storage. Without it the assistants have no settings surface, no consent record and no CLI detection, so they cannot ship.

Spec: @docs/mockups/AUG-194/findings.md (sections 1–5, 7). Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-194/ai-assistants-tab.html. Route: @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Settings has a sixth tab «AI assistants» (id `assistants`) between Projects and Compact mode; `.settings-card` width is `min(680px, 100%)` for every tab so all six tabs fit without scrolling at ≥ 680 px viewports (verified in both themes).
- [ ] The tab renders the four sections of findings.md §1 with the real classes: Status (Claude Code row, PraxisOS row, warn hints + Recheck button only when something is wrong), Meeting Copilot radio list (`.settings-choice-list` / `.settings-choice`, four modes with the exact names, descriptions, tags and price lines), Active session (toggle + Model dropdown / Spending limit per meeting money field / Transcript window dropdown with the exact labels), footer hint. All copy matches the mockup verbatim; no path, port, e-mail, plan name or token count is shown.
- [ ] Both spending limits (`aiSessionBudgetUsd`, `aiCopilotAlwaysBudgetUsd`) are free number fields: `$` prefix + `.settings-input` (96 px, right-aligned, placeholder «0 = no limit», default 2), committed on change (blur / Enter), invalid or negative input reverts to the saved value; 0 means no limit and the hint switches to «No limit: usage is capped only by your Claude plan.»; the consent modal and the Always-on modal show the No-limit sentence variant when the value is 0.
- [ ] Every state of the mockup is reproduced in the app: all off; Local hints; Claude explains with Model child; Always-on with Model + Spending limit children; session on with children; Claude Code not installed / not signed in / too old (Status warn, Claude copilot cards disabled-but-visible, session toggle disabled with «Needs Claude Code — see Status above.»); PraxisOS not running (warn hint, choice still saved); stale session consent (toggle OFF + warn hint, re-enabling reopens the modal); stale copilot consent (card stays selected + warn hint); Recheck shows «Checking…» and is disabled while probing.
- [ ] Consent modal «Active session (Claude)» uses the GroqTextConsentModal pattern with the three lettered lines of findings.md §2, live Transcript window and Spending limit values, hint, Cancel / Agree and enable, Esc and backdrop = Cancel, error line on a failed enable. Always-on Claude confirmation modal (red card, checkbox-gated Turn on) opens every time that mode is chosen.
- [ ] Server: `GET /api/assistant/status[?recheck=1]`, `POST /api/assistant/copilot-mode {mode, accept?, ack?}`, `POST /api/assistant/enable {accept:true}`, `POST /api/assistant/disable` behave exactly as findings.md §3.3 (400 / 409 cases, consent records with version constants, status response shape with `claude {found, signedIn, version, tooOld, checkedAt}`, `praxis {reachable}`, `copilot {...}`, `session {...}`).
- [ ] Preferences: `aiCopilotModel`, `aiCopilotAlwaysBudgetUsd`, `aiModel`, `aiSessionBudgetUsd`, `aiTranscriptWindowMin` are in ALLOWED_KEYS with the sanitizers of findings.md §3.1 (enum drop; budgets: non-finite or negative dropped, rounded to cents, capped at 1000, 0 = no limit; window snapped to 2/5/10/15) in `sanitizeAssistantPreferences()`; `aiCopilotMode`, `aiCopilotConsent`, `aiCopilotAlwaysAck`, `aiSessionEnabled`, `aiConsent` are NOT in ALLOWED_KEYS and are written only by the assistant routes; `DELETE /api/preferences` resets all of them; client `UserPreferences` + `DEFAULT_PREFERENCES` gain the five patched keys with defaults sonnet / 2 / sonnet / 2 / 5.
- [ ] Claude Code detection (`server/src/services/claudeCli.ts`): `resolveClaudeCli()` follows the search order of findings.md §4.1 (CLAUDE_CLI_PATH → win32 `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\claude.exe`, `%APPDATA%\npm\claude.cmd`, `where claude`; darwin `~/.local/bin/claude`, `/opt/homebrew/bin/claude`, `/usr/local/bin/claude`, `which claude`); `probeClaudeCli()` runs `claude --version` and `claude auth status` (JSON, `loggedIn`), 10 s timeouts, `windowsHide`, env without `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, result cached per app start and refreshed by `recheck=1`; `tooOld` when the version is below 2.1.318 or `auth` is an unknown command; only `loggedIn`, `authMethod` and the version are logged.
- [ ] PraxisOS reachability = `GET http://127.0.0.1:7865/health` returns 200 with `status:"ok"` within 1.5 s, no retries.
- [ ] `ensureToolPaths()` in electron/src/main.ts also appends `~/.local/bin` on darwin and stays a no-op on win32.
- [ ] The logged-out JSON of `claude auth status` is captured once on a scratch profile (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) and the parser is verified against it; the result is written into this card.
- [ ] Unit tests: resolver and probe parsing for both `process.platform` values (pattern of gpuBackend.test.ts), sanitizers (preferencesStore.test.ts), consent route rules; `npm test` and `npm run build` pass for client, server and electron.
- [ ] project-context updated: ai-assistants route (Settings section = implemented, status route, detection), preferences route (new keys, server-only keys), frontend-design (tab, card width, choice list, money field), architecture (routes/assistant, claudeCli service).
important_constraints:
- Research is final: do not re-open the decisions of AUG-193 / AUG-196 / AUG-194 (Option A, four copilot modes, Sonnet default, No limit option, 680 px card, Claude modes disabled-but-visible). Follow the mockup pixel for pixel; new CSS classes are named as in findings.md §1.2.
- Both toggles / modes default off: with everything off there is no new process, no new request and no behaviour change for existing users.
- No Claude child is spawned by this task except the two probe commands; the copilot engine (AUG-197) and the session child (AUG-195 impl) consume the status and preferences this task provides.
- Cross-platform per @CLAUDE.md: `process.platform` guards, `path.join` only, Windows `windowsHide: true`, `.cmd` shim via `cmd.exe /d /s /c`; a Cyrillic user directory must work (absolute path, no toSafePath).
- Never show paths, ports, e-mail, plan or model internals in the UI; log counts and booleans only.
- Brutalist UI rules: 0 border-radius, terminal font for the status line and hints, green = primary, yellow = warn, red = Always-on tag and its modal only.
- macOS Keychain access from a GUI child is still unverified (AUG-193 open question): if the probe hangs or prompts on a Mac, report it in the card instead of working around it.

Order: impl of AUG-194 (research 1/3). Depends on: AUG-194-hinr8y (spec). Blocks: AUG-197-5ousfp (copilot needs status + copilot-mode route) and the AUG-195 implementation task. Roadmap: M4 AI assistants.
